description: JOIN queries — multi-table, basic filters across related tables

cases.natural_language: Show me all orders with customer names
cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.*, c.name AS customer_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
cases.description: Basic INNER JOIN between orders and customers

cases.natural_language: Show all customers and their orders, including customers with no orders
cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.*, o.id AS order_id, o.total FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
cases.description: LEFT JOIN to include customers without orders

cases.natural_language: Which customers bought products in the Electronics category?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics'

cases.natural_language: How many orders does each customer have?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name
cases.description: JOIN with GROUP BY and COUNT

cases.natural_language: Find pairs of products in the same category
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p1.name AS product_1, p2.name AS product_2, p1.category FROM products p1 JOIN products p2 ON p1.category = p2.category AND p1.id < p2.id
cases.description: Self-join to find product pairs in same category
